No explicit FHIR-5897 source commit was found; nearby history shows profile/link cleanup, but the Jira comment is the durable application record.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini shows Patient is active in the current core build and lists current core profile spreadsheets, but there is no active DAF/us-core patient-daf profile entry. Current tracked source has no patient-daf, dafpatient, DAF Profile, or stale breadcrumb/package-path strings. Historical git shows the DAF Patient profile moved from source/patient to guides/daf in 2015 and DAF2 guide artifacts, including patient-daf pages/resources, were deleted in 2017.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the requested correction concerned old generated DSTU1 DAF profile pages that are absent from the current core build; there is no current source breadcrumb or navigation path to correct.
